question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Comendation"** is an incorrect spelling of the word **"Commendation".** • **"Commendation"** means **praise or approval**. (प्रशंसा) • **Example:** She received a commendation for her exceptional work on the project. • The incorrect spelling **"Comendation"** is missing an "m". • **"Commendation"** in Hindi is प्रशंसा. • **Example:** उसे परियोजना पर उसके असाधारण कार्य के लिए प्रशंसा मिली। Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Reimbursement** (प्रतिपूर्ति): The act of paying back money to someone. • **Example:** She received reimbursement for her travel expenses. • **Intertwined** (आपस में जुड़ा हुआ): Twisted or woven together. • **Example:** Their lives became increasingly intertwined over the years. • **Competition** (प्रतियोगिता): The activity or condition of striving to gain or win something by defeating others. • **Example:** She won the first prize in the swimming competition. 4a:Tbc9, The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
